reason: A DSH recovery utility centered on snapshots, undo/redo, configuration and plugin-code rollback, safe mode, offline CLI/GUI access, and session-file repair.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供配置与插件代码快照、撤销重做、版本回退、安全模式及离线 CLI/GUI 急救工具。
summaries.en: Provides DSH configuration and plugin-code snapshots, undo and redo, version rollback, safe mode, and offline CLI/GUI recovery tools.

capabilities: Creates and manages snapshots of DSH configuration and user plugin code
Supports undo, redo, restore, removal, export, and import of snapshots
Redacts selected credential files in snapshots and stores original values in a local vault
Enters a safe mode that disables other DSH plugins and can restore related configuration
Scans, repairs, or quarantines supported DSH session files
Can optionally run pnpm install when restoring dependencies
